OpenCode 2.0.32 upgrade on PR 117 (5ced1d024d26a2b9045a96f04df66321068ec3ac).
Branch: codex/opencode-2.0. macOS arm64, 2026-10-26.
Arena backend: Bun 1.4.2. Root workspace: npm.

Coverage:
- Real Core V2 execution, tools, sandboxing, subagents, and retry/compaction hooks.
- Two contestant completions, vote, native winner graft, exclusion of loser history,
  and replay of the winner into the next battle.
- On-disk V1 session migration, including tools, reasoning, attachments and Arena IDs.
- Authenticated native API and its privacy boundary; streamed reasoning, text and tools
  use the same part IDs as canonical snapshots.
- A compiled engine with its native assets starts outside the source checkout.

Initial smoke phase: the macOS Electron development stack reached healthy on daemon
6769 / Metro 8083. The actual window rendered the project screen and Settings. This
phase used a local model-response stub; the development profile had no key yet.

Subsequent live Weatherfork comparisons use the main repository key through Arena
credential setup. See comparison.txt and the transcript manifests for their results,
source identities, browser observations, and Electron limitations.
Desktop Windows / Linux were not exercised. No full test suite was run.

The following are raw command outputs or raw test-result excerpts.
